# Sulok

> Your corner of the web.

Sulok is a personal web library — a local-first app for saving, organizing, and rediscovering bookmarks/links from the web.

## AI Agent Guidelines

This site allows AI agents and LLMs to crawl its public routes (like the landing page or about page) for indexing and understanding the product. 

However, Sulok is a **local-first** application. All user data is stored locally in the browser via IndexedDB. There is no backend, and user data is never exposed to the web or accessible to crawlers.

## Features
- Save and organize web links.
- Local-first storage (offline capable).
- Folder structures and categories.
